blocks.text:
Spend the day in the Sacred Valley of the Incas. First, travel to Chinchero, one of the valley's most colourful villages, known for its weavers. At a textile centre, see traditional Inca techniques for dyeing and spinning alpaca wool. Then visit the Inca square and the colonial church.

Continue to the Moray archaeological complex. Its concentric agricultural terraces served as a kind of laboratory, creating different microclimatic conditions. Lunch follows the visit.

In the afternoon, visit Ollantaytambo, the last living Inca town. Here you will find the Temple of the Ten Windows, the Princess's Bath and the Temple of the Sun. From the upper parts of the complex, there are views over the village and the Sacred Valley. Overnight in the area.
